description: This is a Java interface file defining a Feign client for remote banking core service interactions, specifically for retrieving account details and performing fund transfers.

classes.name: BankingCoreFeignClient
classes.description: A Java interface acting as a Feign client for communication with the core banking service, providing methods to read account details and initiate fund transfers.

methods.name: readAccount
methods.description: Executes a GET request to retrieve account information based on the provided account number.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Executes a POST request to perform a fund transfer with the given request details.
